about: One-factor traversal-worker comparison for the optimised modified-HULHE Deep CFR production candidate.
notes: Learning steps were identically bounded to isolate worker scaling without repeating the expensive 32,000-update diagnostic fit.
The eight-worker run incurred a one-time neural warm-up cost; separated traversal time remains the primary worker-selection measurement.
The production shakedown must remeasure complete iteration cost with the selected 32,000-step advantage budget.
